name: Raul Bautista
summary: A veteran bank robber and master safe technician who recruits Jason and Lucia into high-stakes metropolitan heist operations.
description: Raul Bautista brings decades of armed robbery experience and technical vault-cracking expertise to Leonida's criminal network. Pragmatic and disciplined, Raul mentors Lucia and Jason on tactical planning, alarm suppression, thermal drill logistics, and escape route contingency design.
personality: Meticulous, calm under fire, professional, intolerant of amateur mistakes.

seo.title: Raul Bautista: Heist Mastermind & Bank Robber
seo.description: Dossier on Raul Bautista in GTA VI. Veteran heist organizer, safe technician, and campaign mentor for Lucia and Jason.
